messages:
anna-zhang: Heads-up — hitting a correctness regression in staging for mixed-precision matmul when FP8 kernels are selected after KV warmup. Seen as tiny token diffs that blow up after ~8 tokens. Repro below.

kevin-m: Clarify — is this primarily correctness or perf? Any logs yet?

anna-zhang: Correctness first. Outputs diverge vs bf16 baseline; occasionally we see inf/NaN in activations for a single batch. Perf also slightly regresses (~5%) when fallback happens. Repro steps: 
```
MODEL=llama-13b
RUNTIME=redwood-runtime:v2.3.1-canary
CONFIG=\"quant: fp8, matmul_kernels: auto\"
curl -X POST /v1/generate -d @payload.json
# payload: 4 requests with kv reuse, seq=512, batch=8
```

kevin-m: paste the runtime log snippet if you have it.

anna-zhang: log snippet: 
```
[runtime] kernel=fp8_matmul selected index=3
[perf] batch=8 seq=512 kv_warmup=true
[warn] activation scale underflow -> 0.0
[err] matmul: output contains NaN
```

samir: I reproduced locally. Kernel selector is preferring fp8 for short sequences but when KV cache reuses packed buffers the per-request scale calibration isn't re-applied. Looks like a race between kv-attach and calibration init.

tiago: quick question — does forcing BF16 remove the divergence?

anna-zhang: Forcing BF16/no-quant returns bit-exact outputs to baseline. Quick workaround is --matmul-force-bf16.

perf-bot: Canary deploy 1971123420 includes a soft-disable of fp8 for kv_reuse workloads — rolled to 2% traffic.

kevin-m: Can we convert this into a minimal automated test and add to perf-regress CI? This should be blocked from auto-rollouts until fixed.

samir: Minimal repro script I used: 
```
# repro.sh
for s in 1 2 3 4; do
  python run_client.py --model llama-13b --seq 512 --batch 8 --kv_reuse --quant fp8
done
```
Run a few iterations, you'll see the NaN within 2-3 runs.

tiago: Triaging notes: hypothesis — quant calibration tables are stored per-tensor but the kv-attach code path may rebind buffers without copying calibration metadata. Also batching heuristics could be switching kernels mid-batch leading to mixed-kernel execution on same device block. Both could produce scale mismatch and underflow.

anna-zhang: Assigning to @samir for bisect on kernel selector and kv-attach paths. @kevin-m can you add a canary rule to bias BF16 for kv_reuse until we patch?

kevin-m: On it. Adding traffic rule to prefer BF16 for kv_reuse for 48h and will block auto-upgrades for impacted models. :thumbsup:

samir: Bisect plan: add assertions in kernel init to validate calibration present, run targeted nightly with seq {128,256,512,1024}, and instrument kv-attach to emit cal-table pointers. Will push a debug PR in the next hour.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-7891: "mixed-precision matmul: calibration lost during kv_attach -> NaN in fp8 path". Linked canary deployment and logs.

anna-zhang: Thanks everyone. I've uploaded full traces and perf profiles to /mnt/artifacts/1971123456 (includes perf counters, kernel traces, and payloads). If anyone hits this in prod ping me immediately and we'll widen the bf16 canary.

kevin-m: I'll also add a quick dashboard alert: spike in matmul-fallbacks and NaN rate > 0.1% -> page oncall.

samir: Will follow up with PR link once I have a repro that surfaces the invariant consistently.

tiago: Good catches. Also add a note to the release notes that fp8 kernel auto-selection is disabled for kv_reuse workloads until fix.

anna-zhang: closing loop for now — monitoring canary. Thanks all. :pray:
